data.narrative:
Radian Aerospace is a Seed-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $27.5M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE, though the narrow peer set limits direct comparable analysis.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given available data. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised ($27.5M) as a proxy for current valuation, applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage funding. This yields an implied valuation of $69M. Peer-median analysis was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Space & Aerospace sector—only one peer met the narrow screening criteria. Public-comp anchoring using the sector P/S median of 24.6x across the five public tickers could not be applied because Radian's revenue is not disclosed, a constraint common to private-company analysis.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $58M (low) to $79M (high), with a median of $69M. The range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression output. Key uncertainties include the appropriate multiplier for Radian's specific market position, product maturity relative to peers, and near-term revenue trajectory. Obtaining private peer valuation data or target revenue would strengthen conviction in this range.
